summary: Independent v10 reviews confirm the exact-envp/-s -S -P effective-hash fix, but found two P1 architecture gaps: retained admission schema still expects RunnerExecutionClosure v1 while the fixed policy exists only in v2, and complete replay-section replacement omitted the full M6 input inventory/no-free-path contract. The adversarial review also found umask was declared as environment data rather than an observed pre-exec process state.

limitations: Independent reviewers were read-only and made no product, test, contract, gate, ledger, or historical-evidence changes.
No training, replay, PIT certification, budget consumption, or final-OOS access occurred.

blockers: Test design, implementation, M7 contract freeze/fit, archival replay, CCC/Gate experiments, and final-OOS access remain prohibited until the revised architecture/design passes independent review.
